_doc: EXP-1248: THE list item, x4 (web @exp/ui SessionRow + PrRow over ListRow, desktop run_rows/flat_row, iOS SessionRow + PrRow over .flatRow, Android SessionRow + PrRow over Modifier.flatRow). Anatomy: [tree guides overlay][lead glyph at base + indent*depth][mono identifier][title][caption, big only][trailing meta]. NO fold chevron (children always show; trees cap at 10 runs), NO trailing chevron, NO buttons. The lead box is `mark` wide at x = base + indent*depth on EVERY row, so marks and titles at one depth align exactly and a child's connector elbow ends at its own lead (tree-guides). SessionRow: small = one line (title line + trailing device icon, height small); big = two lines (title line, caption line under the title, trailing device icon, height big). PrRow: one line, lead = prNode, height prRow (prRowPhone below md); a stack renders top-first with a 1px rail through the node centres down to a trailing base-branch row (mono, muted); the current member wears the active row wash. sessionRowCaption({ended, paused, state, device, startedAt, updatedAt, endedAt, blockedLabel, now}) = the big row's caption + tone, first match wins: ended -> 'Done · <device> · <when>' muted (when = now - (endedAt else updatedAt)); paused -> 'Paused · <device>' muted; blockedLabel (the usage wall's badge label) -> that label, amber; else by the live display state (session-display.json, its statusTone): working -> 'Building · <device> · <elapsed>' (elapsed = now - startedAt), needs_input -> 'Needs input · <device> · <elapsed>', review -> 'Ready for review · <device> · <when>' (when = now - updatedAt), done -> 'Done · <device> · <when>'. A missing device or an unparsable/missing timestamp drops that segment. listElapsed(ms) = the list's coarse age ladder: under a minute 'now', then '<m> min', '<h> h', '<d> d' (floored; a negative span reads 'now').

captions.name: a working run builds on its device
a run that waits on you is amber
an open PR is ready for review since its last activity
a live idle run with no PR is done, sky
an ended run is done, muted, since it ended
an ended run without an end stamp falls back to its heartbeat
an offline host pauses the run
a walled run reads its usage wall
an unparsable start drops the time

prNodes.name: an open PR is an emerald ring
the current member fills the centre
the base branch is a muted ring
